squares ahead.

magic circles in the room

dialogue.sp_home005.sp|36:
Good morning, Mikhail.
What brings you here so
bright and early?
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|24:
Oh, what has Father done
this time?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|63:
Well, Mikhail, what should
we do about it?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|131:
All right, Mikhail,
I've made up my mind.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|59:
Bestill my heart no!
I wouldn't dream of it.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|21:
Father must be down there,
waiting for me to
come help him!
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|15:
I can't let his hopes
be in vain.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|16: I'll entrust his fate to you.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|78:
What have we here?
You're not already on your way?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|91:
Understood. I'll ask our maid
to prepare those items for
you.
Milady, please wait in
your room.
Now, if you'll excuse me...
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|6:
Miss, I brought the items
you requested.
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|100:
Thank you, Lucille.
And with that, I should be
all set to go.
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|91:
Oh geez, talk about blunt!
You didn't have to say that.
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|22:
He's been spirited away by
monsters.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|142:
Ghoulish creatures crawled
up through that fissure and
abducted the professor.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|45:
Monsters grabbed Father?
But why would they?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|81:
How do you believe we ought
to proceed?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|167:
Huh? Might you have just said
something?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|170: I'm going to go rescue Father!
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|42:
Well, what else would you
have me do?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|96:
Then I guess our only option
is for me to go.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|30:
But yet! Milady, I can't allow
you to place yourself in
harm's way.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|155:
Oh, I'll be fine. After all,
I've got this dress you made
for me, don't I.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|120:
To be sure, with that dress'
powers you do at least stand
a chance.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|14:
Though that doesn't change
the fact that it's hardly
safe.
I'm not certain I could allow
it in good conscience...
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|146:
I..see. I understand how you
feel. And yet I worry...
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|64:
Well then, how about you
come along with me?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|17:
This is a task you are
uniquely qualified for,
milady.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|166:
You'd have me set off just
like this? Empty-handed?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|80:
What would you want to bring,
aside from the magic dress?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|140:
Food, for starters, would be
nice. And perhaps a lantern
and matches...
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|47:
Let me do one last check to
be sure I'm ready.
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|80:
Let's see... Food, water,
lantern, matches...
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|35:
Heheh, Miss, why not quit now
while you're ahead?
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|93:
Huh, what? You're saying
there's no point in
double-checking my
provisions? It wouldn't do to
forget anything important.
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|26:
What, then, are you trying to
say?
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|25:
It's already too late for the
professor.
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|67:
Think about it.
What do monsters usually do
to someone they take?
I can't fathom that he'd still
be unharmed.

The professor's probably
being greedily devoured right
about now,
with the monsters leaving
nary a trace of him for you
to find.
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|57:
If you ran off to rescue a
dead person and then met that
same fate yourself,
it would be pretty idiotic,
no?
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|129:
I'll be fine.
As long as I have this magic
dress,
I needn't worry no matter how
perilous the going gets.
dialogue.sp120.sp|1:
Surely this must be
holy water right?!
Let's scoop some up.
dialogue.sp_home041.sp|56:
I've got myself some
holy water. I better find
the other sacred item fast.
dialogue.sp_home041.sp|135:
I found holy water,
but I'm still working on
the other one.
dialogue.sp_home041.sp|57:
Sacred items and magic
are related,
or so I've heard...
Thus it stands to reason,
they ought to...
dialogue.sp_home040.sp|54:
Ah!
The bible and holy water
are glowing?!
dialogue.sp_home040.sp|3:
I bestow power onto you.
Onto your soul and into your
dress,
The power necessary for
your task.
dialogue.sp_home040.sp|23:
It is the power to protect
someone important to you.

Hallowed power to purify
the wicked.
dialogue.sp_home040.sp|49:
Now that I have this
sacred sword, I should be
able to help Father. Surely!
dialogue.sp129.sp|16:
I'm fine. I can't die yet.
I still have work to do
after all.
dialogue.sp_home027.sp|102:
The purpose of Astulla,
the ceremony we're about
to perform,
is to turn you into a
human being, milady.
dialogue.sp_home027.sp|71:
Alice. You are simply
my daughter.

And that is why we're holding
this ceremony. All right?
dialogue.sp_home027.sp|80:
Good. Mikhail!
Let's begin the rite!
dialogue.sp_home027.sp|44:
Mother of all life,
oh endless land.
dialogue.sp_home027.sp|127:
Earth to Mikhail,
get ahold of yourself man!
dialogue.sp_home027.sp|72:
Keekkekekekeke! Oh I had
nooo idea such a thing
would happen.
dialogue.sp_home027.sp|43:
In fact, how about you start
with the pesky brat there?

and give her an especially
brutal demise!
dialogue.sp132.sp|8:
Everyone I care about will
be gone!
Unacceptable!
dialogue.sp_home005.sp|1:
I have finished preparing
breakfast,

so if you would please
make your way to the
dining room.
dialogue.sp_home027.sp|40:
I told you, right? Mikhail and
Lucille are two sides of the
same coin.
She likely still lives on,
deep within him.

Not that she'll be able to
assert herself again, though.
dialogue.sp_home027.sp|16:
Alice has been pushing the
limits of her endurance,

putting up a brave front so
that she wouldn't cause us
to worry.
The strain has caught up to
her, and her body really has
run out of time.
dialogue.sp_home006.sp|1:
I wish he would spend a bit
more time with me.
It's just a smidge,
but some days I can feel
a little lonely.
dialogue.sp_home004.sp|43:
Indeed it is.
Invading his privacy would be
uncouth,
but, should I read a little
of it?
dialogue.sp_home004.sp|3:
Watching her expressions
ebb and flow like the tide,

made me feel happy for
some reason.
dialogue.sp_home004.sp|42:
If this keeps up I fear that
we will be in serious danger.

I've got to think of
some way....
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|168:
Milady. Have you packed all
you need?

Do you have your
handkerchief?
And some tissues?
dialogue.sp_home041.sp|9:
How about I try asking the
vampire?

He seems like he might know
something about sacred items.
dialogue.sp_home010.sp|77:
Yes, we narrowly escaped
being crushed.

That, and everything else too,
was all thanks to you, Alice.
dialogue.sp_home027.sp|49:
Your body has been pushed to
its limits.

Now you're on Death's
doorstep, reaching out to
knock.
dialogue.sp132.sp|27:
Well now, this fight might
just be winnable after all.

This holy sword might be
enough to topple that
abomination.
dialogue.sp_home004.sp|2:
These enjoyable days quietly
pass one after the next.

I hope life can continue to be
like this....
dialogue.sp_home041.sp|125:
Hurry, milady! Use the
holy sword to rescue
the professor!
